title: USDA NASS Quick Stats
agency: U.S. Department of Agriculture, National Agricultural Statistics Service
questions: prices received by farmers for wheat
number of farms by county from the Census of Agriculture

manual.how: Build the same query on https://quickstats.nass.usda.gov/ (no key needed: pick Program, Sector, Group, Commodity, Category, Data Item, Geographic Level, State and Year, then Get Data > Spreadsheet) and upload the CSV; or, with a key, run the download script in the bundle.

cache.why: Estimates are revised with each report (annual summaries revise earlier forecasts); queries are small.

redistribution.why: NASS statistics are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); the Quick Stats API terms govern access and rate of use, not reuse of the data.

notices: This product uses the NASS API but is not endorsed or certified by NASS.
citation: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service, Quick Stats ({dataset}), quickstats.nass.usda.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Survey estimates (annual and monthly) or the Census of Agriculture (every five years, county detail)? They differ and must not be mixed in one series.
Marketing-year or calendar-year values? Prices received are published monthly and as marketing-year averages.
